description:
Implement only the BenchBox core adopter contract: reject mismatches against explicitly supplied expected version, fork_sha, upstream_sha and wheel SHA256; preserve transactional restore of archive/pin/notice/baseline identity and forward-update/explicit-rollback behavior; route _vendor-only updates to existing installed wheel/sdist package smoke. Reuse scripts/adopt_sqlglot_wheel.py and existing core runtime/distribution helpers. Delivery-record trust (producer repository/workflow/ref/event/run/attempt/artifact origin) belongs exclusively to sqlglot-e2e-core-wheel-consumer, not this root item. Test against an explicitly identified canonical #80 wheel or another existing canonical artifact, supplying exact expected fields; no new producer-record dependency is needed for these independent consumer-tooling fixes.

Exercise only unique core wrapper/options, pin/update and packaged private/public-runtime integration. Inventory proposed adoption-specific tests against fork proof; no upstream discovery/source fetching/ancestry reconstruction, fork source-to-wheel verifier, relocation suite, engine matrix or new packaging matrix in core. Retain ordinary required core CI and existing freshness/advisory/public-release/security policies unchanged; those release-policy gates are not this adoption orchestrator. No automatic outcome/test/golden edits or Theseus change.
